logger.doc:name: start register covid cases process
logger.message: "transactionID:" #[vars.transactionID], "correlationID:" #[vars.correlationID], message: "Started register covid case process" with "payload:" #[payload]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { zip: payload.address.postal, fname: payload.firstName, country: payload.address.country, city: payload.address.city, source: payload.source, "type": payload.caseType, nationalIDType: payload.nationalIDType, lname: payload.lastName, createBy: "UHIS", nationalID: payload.nationalID, phone: payload.phone, updateBy: "UHIS", dob: payload.dateOfBirth, street: payload.address.streetAddress, state: payload.address.state, email: payload.email }

db:insert.doc:name: insert into db
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO UHUB.CVD_CASE_MASTER (SOURCE, CASE_TYPE, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, DATE_OF_BIRTH, NATIONAL_ID, NATIONAL_ID_TYPE, STREET_ADDRESS, CITY, STATE, POSTAL, COUNTRY, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY) VALUES (:source, :type, :fname, :lname, :phone, :email, :dob, :nationalID, :nationalIDType, :street, :city, :state, :zip, :country, :createBy, :updateBy);

logger.doc:name: End of the covid case registration process
logger.message: TransactionID: #[vars.transactionID], correlationID: #[vars.correlationID], message: record inserted successfully, payload: #[payload]
